# EmPower Solar Transition to Marcor Solar
EmPower Solar is no longer conducting business operations[cite: 1, 3]. 

## Customer Support Transition
Marcor Solar has stepped forward to assist EmPower Solar customers with their ongoing solar and home energy needs[cite: 1, 3]. Marcor Solar handles system monitoring, repairs, technical support, and expansions[cite: 1, 3].

## Warranty Status
- Workmanship Warranties: Marcor Solar is a separate entity and is unable to honor workmanship warranties originally provided by EmPower Solar[cite: 1, 3].
- Equipment Warranties: Equipment warranties (panels, inverters, batteries) direct from the manufacturer remain valid[cite: 1, 3]. Marcor Solar can facilitate these claims for a fee[cite: 1, 3].
